about.subtitle: About Aliyaat
about.title: Ensuring Industrial Excellence Through Reliability.
about.description: Aliyaat was founded with a clear mission: to bridge the gap between top-tier industrial machinery and the workshops that rely on them. We are more than just a service provider; we are your technical partner on the factory floor.

services.title: Comprehensive Maintenance Services
services.description: From emergency fixes to long-term optimization, our diverse range of services ensures your machinery operates at peak performance.
services.cta_description: Contact our technical team to discuss your specific factory requirements.

corrective.title: Corrective Maintenance
corrective.description: Rapid, on-site emergency repairs to minimize operational downtime and restore functionality.

preventive.title: Preventive Maintenance
preventive.description: Scheduled inspections and servicing to prevent failures and extend the lifespan of your machinery.

procurement.title: Procurement Support
procurement.description: Expert assistance in sourcing, vetting, and acquiring the ideal machinery for your specific needs.

consultation.title: Technical Consultation
consultation.description: Strategic advice on optimizing your production line, improving efficiency, and long-term planning.

training.title: Operator Training
training.description: Comprehensive training programs to ensure your team can operate new machinery safely and effectively.

products.title: Machine Procurement
